headlines.title_en: Xi Jinping leaves Beijing for 2026 SCO Summit and state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
headlines.summary_en: On the morning of Aug 30, President Xi Jinping left Beijing by special plane for Bishkek to attend the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization Summit, and to pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt at the invitation of Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov and Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi. Xi's wife Peng Liyuan, Cai Qi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, and Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of Foreign Affairs, accompanied him on the visits. (Xinhua)

headlines.summary_en: Nanjing Housing Provident Fund Management Center announced on August 29 that, to better leverage the role of the housing provident fund system and further meet homebuyers' cross-regional housing consumption needs, the scope of housing provident fund cross-regional loans will be expanded to nationwide. headlines.title_en: 2026 National Social Science Fund Annual Project Review Meeting held in Beijing; Li Shulei attends and speaks
headlines.summary_en: Jin 10 Data Aug 30 - The 2026 National Social Science Fund Annual Project Review Work Conference was held in Beijing on Aug 30. Li Shulei, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and head of the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, attended and delivered a speech. The meeting stressed that Chinese modernization provides a rich practical foundation and broad innovation space for the high-quality development of philosophy and social sciences. It is necessary to focus on the primary task, fully utilize disciplinary resources and methods, and deepen the systematic and theoretical research and interpretation of the Party's innovative theories. Accelerate the construction of an independent knowledge system for Chinese philosophy and social sciences, actively research and solve major theoretical and practical issues of Chinese modernization, promote the creative transformation and innovative development of fine traditional Chinese culture, and foster exchanges and mutual learning among civilizations. Efforts should be made to build a research management system and organizational form conducive to solving real problems, deepen the systematic reform of the National Social Science Fund, advocate a fine academic style, and improve academic evaluation.

headlines.summary: 隆基绿能公告，上半年，国内新增光伏装机阶段性回调，公司实现营业收入270.45亿元，同比下降17.58%。同时，受制于行业供需失衡背景下开工率不足，产品毛利率持续低位，叠加第一季度银价高位推升成本导致的部分集中式订单交付损失，联营企业投资损失及人民币升值带来的汇兑损失等多重影响，报告期内公司实现归属于上市公司股东的净亏损36.84亿元。

headlines.title_en: LONGi Green Energy: Net loss of 3.684 billion yuan in H1
headlines.summary_en: LONGi Green Energy announced that in the first half of the year, new domestic PV installations saw a phased pullback, with the company achieving operating revenue of 27.045 billion yuan, down 17.58% year-on-year. Meanwhile, due to insufficient capacity utilization amid industry supply-demand imbalance, product gross margins remained low, coupled with delivery losses on some centralized orders driven by high silver prices in Q1, investment losses from associates, and exchange losses from RMB appreciation, the company recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of listed company of 3.684 billion yuan for the reporting period.

headlines.title_en: UAE to investigate Banque Misr after US alleges Iran links
headlines.summary_en: The UAE central bank said it will investigate Banque Misr after the U.S. Treasury took action to cut off the Egyptian bank's UAE branch from the U.S. financial system as part of sanctions on Iran. In a statement, the UAE central bank said it had "decided to conduct a special urgent examination of the bank's transactions during the period of more than two years covered by the U.S. Friday announcement." Its investigation "includes a retrospective forensic/in-depth review covering the period referred to in the U.S. authorities' statement, focusing on bank transactions with companies mentioned in the statement."

headlines.title_en: Tibet Gyirong briefing: 2,141 rescue personnel mobilized for frontline search
headlines.summary_en: Today (30th), a press conference on the '8.26' mudslide disaster in Gyirong, Tibet, was held in Gyirong Town. It was reported that after the disaster, Tibet quickly activated the regional Level I natural disaster emergency response and Level I natural disaster relief emergency response, establishing the Gyirong County '8.26' mudslide disaster emergency rescue command and front-line command. The Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Emergency Management urgently allocated 120 million yuan, and the National Development and Reform Commission arranged 100 million yuan to support rescue and post-disaster recovery. Currently, a total of 2,141 rescue personnel from the PLA, armed police, China Fire and Rescue, border defense, public security, and China Aneng, among others, have been mobilized, with 269 rescue vehicles and 3,922 sets of rescue equipment deployed to the front line for search and rescue. Rescue efforts are now advancing to the core disaster area by land, water, and air. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 隆基绿能：2026年半年度净亏损36.84亿元
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月30日讯，隆基绿能发布2026年半年度报告，公司上半年实现营业收入270.45亿元，同比下降17.58%；归属于上市公司股东的净利润亏损36.84亿元，上年同期亏损25.69亿元；基本每股收益-0.49元/股。报告期内，公司业绩主要受到行业供需失衡导致开工率不足、产品毛利率持续低位，以及第一季度银价高位推升成本带来的部分集中式订单交付损失、联营企业投资损失和人民币升值汇兑损失等多重因素的影响。

headlines.title_en: LONGi Green Energy: Net loss of 3.684 billion yuan in H1 2026
headlines.summary_en: Jin 10 Data Aug 30 - LONGi Green Energy released its 2026 semi-annual report, with operating revenue of 27.045 billion yuan in H1, down 17.58% year-on-year; net loss attributable to shareholders of listed company of 3.684 billion yuan, versus a loss of 2.569 billion yuan in the same period last year; basic EPS of -0.49 yuan per share. During the reporting period, performance was mainly affected by multiple factors including insufficient capacity utilization due to industry supply-demand imbalance, persistently low product gross margins, delivery losses on some centralized orders from high silver prices in Q1, investment losses from associates, and exchange losses from RMB appreciation.

headlines.title: 安克创新：2026年上半年净利润17.02亿元，同比增长45.86%
headlines.summary: 安克创新公告，2026年上半年营业收入166.05亿元，同比增长29.05%；归属于上市公司股东的净利润17.02亿元，同比增长45.86%，上年同期为11.67亿元；扣除非经常性损益的净利润14.39亿元，同比增长49.65%。公司拟每10股派发现金红利人民币8元（含税），预计派发现金红利4.7亿元（含税）。

headlines.title_en: Anker Innovations: Net profit of 1.702 billion yuan in H1 2026, up 45.86% YoY
headlines.summary_en: Anker Innovations announced that in the first half of 2026, operating revenue was 16.605 billion yuan, up 29.05% year-on-year; net profit attributable to shareholders of listed company was 1.702 billion yuan, up 45.86% year-on-year, versus 1.167 billion yuan in the same period last year; non-GAAP net profit was 1.439 billion yuan, up 49.65% year-on-year. The company plans to distribute a cash dividend of RMB 8 (pre-tax) per 10 shares, with an estimated total cash dividend of 470 million yuan (pre-tax).

headlines.title: 天风证券2026年半年报成绩亮眼 “六新天风”建设成效显现
headlines.summary: 8月30日上午，国家主席习近平乘专机离开北京，赴比什凯克出席2026年上海合作组织峰会，应吉尔吉斯斯坦总统扎帕罗夫、埃及总统塞西邀请对两国进行国事访问。陪同习近平出访的有：习近平主席夫人彭丽媛，中共中央政治局常委、中央办公厅主任蔡奇，中共中央政治局委员、外交部部长王毅等。（新华社）
